cited.quote: Disseminating market price and price forecast to the registered farmers through SMS, print and web media

rationale: C1 (2019 policy note) lists SMS dissemination of market prices as an ongoing departmental activity; C3 describes the same activity before. No GO, launch or new scheme is shown, so this is the same activity carrying on with no official step.

cited.quote: accord sanction of Rs.100.00 Crore (Rupees one hundred crore only) from out of Rs.200.00 Crore

rationale: C1 is a GO dated 2019-09-09 sanctioning Rs.100 crore for a skill training programme for 50,000 marginalised candidates, implemented through TNSDC. C3 (2021) is a later GO for urban youth training. The promise is generic, so C1 is taken as the first dedicated GO for special employment training.

cited.quote: The compensation for human death and permanent incapacitation has been raised from Rs.3.00 lakh to Rs.4.00 lakh
From 2016-17, the compensation is paid at the enhanced rate.

rationale: C1 reports that during 2016-17 the Government enhanced wildlife-damage compensation (death Rs.3 lakh to Rs.4 lakh, injury and property rates also raised). C3 confirms payment at the enhanced rate from 2016-17. No GO date is given, so only the year is stated.

cited.quote: In order to quickly settle medical reimbursement bills of the insured persons and their family members

rationale: The promise does not name the fund. C1 describes the ESI revolving fund created in 2004 and its use in 2016-17, with no order raising it or widening its service. C2, C4 (UIDSSMT revolving fund) and C3, C5 (startup revolving grant) concern other funds and beneficiaries.

cited.quote: Implementation of Replanting and Rejuvenation of Coconut Gardens in Tamil Nadu at a cost of
Sanction of Livelihood Package for the Coconut farmers affected by Gaja Cyclone

rationale: Directional promise. C5 is a GO dated 2016-12-30 giving administrative approval to a coconut garden replanting and rejuvenation scheme costing Rs.20 crore, a dedicated measure for coconut growers. C2 is a later GO (2018-12-31) sanctioning a livelihood package for coconut farmers.

cited.quote: Sanction of Livelihood Package for the Coconut farmers affected by Gaja Cyclone
for a total area of 4,470 Hectare (11,175 Acre) for implementation in

rationale: Directional promise. C2 is a GO dated 2018-12-31 sanctioning a Rs.81.015 crore livelihood package (seedlings, intercropping, drip irrigation) for coconut farmers. C1 shows an earlier replanting and rejuvenation scheme sanctioned in 2016-17 but gives no exact date, so the dated GO is used.

cited.quote: Bicycles are supplied to the students belonging to Adi Dravidar, Scheduled Tribes and Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity

rationale: The promise is to urge the Centre to list converted Adi Dravidars. Extracts C1-C3 mention converted Adi Dravidars only as beneficiaries of state education schemes, which is not a formal step of advocacy. C4 and C5 are unrelated GOs. No resolution, letter or GO to the Union appears.

cited.quote: Construction of Elevated road from Chennai Port to Maduravoyal (NH-4) in Tamil Nadu

rationale: C2 is a GO of 2019-01-31 accepting the state's nomination to an NHAI committee examining viability of the Chennai Port to Maduravoyal elevated road on NH-4. This is an official step but only preparatory; no administrative sanction to construct is shown. C1 and C4 concern DPR for roads in Thoothukudi, not elevated NH.

cited.quote: Construction of Elevated road from Chennai Port to Maduravoyal (NH-4) in Tamil Nadu
Construction of Elevated Highway along Avinashi road in Coimbatore City from Uppilipalayam to Chinniampalayam

rationale: C5 is a GO of 2019-01-31 on an NHAI viability committee for the Chennai Port to Maduravoyal elevated road, a preparatory step only. C2 merely lists elevated highway works, and C4 is a feasibility report for a state highway corridor. No extract shows construction starting.

cited.quote: Establishment of Inland Fish Landing Centres in Thirumoorthy and Amaravathy Reservoirs
dredging works at fishing harbour basins at Nagapattinam, Pazhayar and Cuddalore

rationale: C5 is a GO dated 2020-02-25 sanctioning inland fish landing centres. C1 reports completed dredging at fishing harbour basins and landing centre basins at Rs.17.80 crore, and a sanctioned feasibility study for new harbours. Both parts are addressed, but the only dated order is C5.

cited.quote: recommending license to the Coconut Producers Company and further activities related to production of Neera

rationale: C3 and C1 mention Coconut Producers Societies/Company only in the context of Neera licensing and planned training. C4 and C5 are GOs on general farmer producer groups and organisations, not coconut producer companies. No order establishing coconut producer companies or coconut production training is shown.

cited.quote: an additional 20 Mobile Medical Units are being operationalized through NGOs in tribal blocks of 13 Districts

rationale: C2 (and C4) says 20 additional tribal Mobile Medical Units are being operationalised, but gives no GO or date. C1 shows 416 Hospital on Wheels units in 2015-16 and C2 shows 395, so the overall number did not rise. C3 and C5 only use existing units for occupational health.

cited.quote: the Government has set a target of achieving 2000MW of solar power generation

rationale: Extracts concern solar but none shows an order or plan for 3,000 MW. C1 cites the 2012 policy target of 2000MW and small rooftop capacity; C2 and C3 list subsidies and a 72.22 MW commissioned total; C4 and C5 are GOs for 1000 solar pumps. These are related activity, not this target.

cited.quote: started the distribution of free Set Top Boxes on 01.09.2017

rationale: C3 says the Chief Minister started distribution of free set-top boxes on 01.09.2017 and 36.40 lakh boxes have been distributed to subscribers; C1 and C5 show the tender, the sanction GO (30.5.2017) and 34.51 lakh boxes distributed. Free distribution to government cable subscribers is operational.

cited.quote: An accidental death assistance of rupees one lakh and natural death assistance of Rs.25,000 are extended

rationale: C1 and C2 describe Labour Welfare Board assistance (Rs.1 lakh accidental death, Rs.25,000 natural death) with no increase. C4 and C5 are grant-release GOs for the unorganised workers boards, and C5's enhancement applies to those boards, not the Labour Welfare Board.

cited.quote: Natural death assistance 15,000/- 3 Funeral expenses assistance 2,000/-
release a sum of Rs.15,40,00,000/- (Rupees fifteen crores and forty lakhs only) under General Category

rationale: C2 lists the assistance amounts for unorganised workers with no increase. C4 and C5 are GOs releasing budgeted grants to the boards; routine releases are not an order raising the assistance. C1 and C3 only describe the boards. No increase order appears.

The promise text 'Fulfill these works' names no work, object or beneficiary. The extracts cover MGNREGS works, the Self Sufficiency Scheme, child labour and irrigation works, none of which can be tied to the commitment, so no extract is about it.

cited.quote: The interest chargeable is 6% per annum and repayable in 12 to 18 monthly

rationale: The promise is interest-free loans up to Rs.1,000 repaid at Rs.10 a week, plus an Amma Banking Card. C3 shows a different loan fund at 6% interest (Rs.1000-7500) and C1 SHG bank linkage; no interest-free loan scheme or banking card appears. C2, C4 and C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: A Venture Capital Fund will be created with a corpus of Rs. 500 cr., to support entrepreneurs

rationale: C1 is GO (Ms) No 74 of 2021-02-11 implementing the New Industrial Policy, stating a Venture Capital Fund with a Rs.500 cr corpus 'will be created' for sunrise-sector entrepreneurs, with guidelines to be issued separately. An official step, but not an operational fund and not clearly the first-generation MSME fund promised.

cited.quote: two-tier bunk cots, inverter, reference books, instant wet grinder, steam boiler are supplied to college hostels
Idly cooker-cum-steam boilers and washing machines will be provided to all the hostels in the

rationale: C1 (2017) announces steam boilers for all hostels. C2 (2020-21 policy note) reports steam boilers supplied to college hostels only, not school hostels. That covers part of the promise. No GO or launch date is given, so only the year of the policy note is used.
